name: Belluna Co., Ltd.
summary: Belluna Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, operates in the mail order industry. It operates through eight segments: Apparel and Miscellaneous Goods Business, Cosmetics and Health Food Business, Gourmet Business, Nursing-related Business, Database Utilization Business, Kimono-related Business, Property Business, and Other Business. The Apparel and Miscellaneous Goods Business segment provides clothing, household items, furniture, and personal and hobby goods through catalogs, internet, and other media, as well as engages in apparel and general merchandise business.
